steps.instruction: Thread 6 grapes, alternating green and red, onto each wooden skewer.
steps.spoken: Thread 6 grapes onto each 6-inch wooden skewer, alternating the green and red grapes. You will use 48 green and 48 red grapes in all.

steps.instruction: Freeze the skewers for 30 minutes, until frozen.
